Gastric mucin oligosaccharides remaining after bacterial growth

glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12.Rd

LC-MS profiles of oligosaccharides in culture supernatants after growth of Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron on porcine gastric mucin O-glycans. Wild-type and fucosidase-deficient strains are compared with the glycan substrate control to examine the contribution of fucose removal to mucin utilization. Supplementary Table S12 contains 140 features and four observations.

Usage

glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12

Format

A glyexp::GlycomicSE with 140 features and 4 observations. The abundance assay is in percentage of source total glycan AUC.

Source

GlycoPOST GPST000643. Supplementary Table S12, sheet named Table 12 (media-13.xlsx). Study: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.26.714468. Repository: https://glycopost.glycosmos.org/entry/GPST000643.

Details

The source conditions are Control (gMO), the double alpha-1,2-fucosidase deletion strain lacking bt3173 and bt4682, that double deletion with an additional bt1842 deletion, and wild-type B. thetaiotaomicron. These are culture-supernatant glycan profiles, not bacterial counts or gene-expression measurements. One percentage column is available for each condition; no biological replicate type is assigned.

Percentages are normalized to source total glycan AUC. Feature row 48 has conflicting composition and putative-structure residue counts; both source assignments are retained and flagged in annotation_consistency. Digestion products and residual substrate glycans should be interpreted together in this extracellular measurement space.

Typed compositions retain source mass/isomer labels, and 95 putative structures are encoded. Ambiguous source structures remain as text.

See also

glyhub_data_conventions for missing-value handling, annotations and access to original measurements and source coordinates.
